method: Exact deployed production runtime served locally after byte comparison against the live index, offline manifest and all JavaScript/CSS/WASM assets. Fresh Chrome contexts, normal file imports, visible navigation and native exports only. No DOM, storage, case, rule or result injection; no publication or external operating action.

checks: Workflow Excel tools are collapsed under Work with Excel.

Input group and section changes leave the selected workflow report intact; report navigation and Forms/YAML preserve an unapplied form value. Discarding the draft restores its original value without changing the native run.
The retained gifting workflow has no horizontal page overflow at 390px.
The frozen standalone teaching app opens Decision and switches to the complete Supporting reports hierarchy. Its old release has no authored Forms schema and keeps complete-case YAML available.
bounds: Existing v2 teaching and separately adapted rule releases retain their native hashes. The v3 paired operating outcomes and custom CLI/SDK desk captures are unaffected and remain on their exact prior artifacts.
